methodological_implications.explanation: The 500 sources used to evaluate Logistic Regression and Random Forest are the exact first 500 sources (te[:500]) of the 1,500 held-out primary test set. In shortcut_baseline.py, ForensicNet was simultaneously evaluated on these exact same 500 sources (AUC 0.8477), yielding a strictly valid paired bootstrap difference (+0.2982 Delta AUC vs RF, +0.2908 vs LR). However, comparing baseline results on 500 sources directly against the headline 1,500-source primary result (AUC 0.8543) without noting the subset difference is an unadjusted comparison. Both 500-source paired and 1,500-source full evaluations are documented in this audit.
